notes.title: RELEASE DATE AND NEW TRAILER!
notes.notes:
[b]It's almost time to step out of the shadows – we're excited to share the news that UNDETECTED will be launching on Steam (and other PC storefronts) on the 30th September! If you haven't already, be sure to add the game to your wishlist and you'll receive a reminder on launch day as soon as it's available.[/b]

Watch the new release date trailer:

notes.title: Demo V1.1 Patch now available!
notes.notes:
[b]Demo v1.1 Patch Now Available![/b]

Thanks to everyone who has tried UNDETECTED and sent feedback! We are working on making it the best it can be!

[b]New features for the demo:[/b]

[list]
[*] New visibility indicator - Kaan's tattoos glow when he is invisible
[*] New difficulty mode "Classic" - for people who want the classic stealth action experience
[*] Fixed issues with long grass and lights
[/list]
